author: olivine w

title: Take trial before paying
body:
There is no way to select a goal just from the list - it has to be set as repeated DAILY, what if I don’t want to do it daily but want to check out if I did it? No way to track PAST actions too. 
Very little settings on how do you wish to see those colorful mess inside app, I’d prefer less noise but I like SOME of it. Too much dev effort on UI and articles inside and too less on actual functionality. I paid and I deeply regret not choosing trial before paying please don’t fall for discounts and ACTUALLY try it first
